notes.title: UPDATE 8
notes.content:
[X] new enemy: shadowman
[X] new enemy: turret plant
[X] new enemy: trapper mage
[X] turned spikebat into a stunStick
[X] 4 new difficulty skulls
[X] new theme music

tweaks:
- added more gore and explosion/fire marks
- improved world lighting
- buffed flamethrower
- zeroHero curse is now 75% chance to lose your weapon
- explosive feet now throws nades
- take less dmg from your own explosions
- death does less dmg
- explosive zombies do not show up every stage now
- blastDoctor buffed to heal 2hp
- fixed bug where explosions weren't breaking walls
- blessing/curse re-roll cost is now only 5hp (highRoller makes it 2)
- weapon ammo counts adjusted
- fixed "things cost more" skull
- melee items cost £200 now
- removed the start without a gun skull
- locked cursor better for windowed mode
- nerfed more enemies skull (about 15% more enemies now, not 25%)

twitter: @glovegames
youtube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCyn_t7dt2cM1sKt49ETBlxA

- new level details and randomization
- new items are auto mapped to hotkeys
